idea.title: A carousel template should be reviewed at phone size, not only on the canvas
idea.summary: A reusable Arabic carousel template pass showed that heading scale, footer weight, and comparison hierarchy can look acceptable at 1080 pixels while losing balance at a 360 pixel feed view. Exported PNGs and a phone-size contact sheet made those problems concrete.

context.goal: Improve reusable personal carousel templates while preserving the existing authoring contract and renderer pipeline.
context.situation: The renderer had a warm palette and distinct layouts, but several shared heading sizes and fixed offsets produced sparse or oversized compositions in the active carousel.
context.investigation: Compared the design direction and template references with full-size exports and a 360 pixel contact sheet, then traced workspace data through the adapter, SlideRenderer, layouts, Studio preview, and export route.
context.decision: Keep the seven authoring layout IDs and their adapter mapping, then refine shared typography, spacing, label/value scale, and footer treatment in the presentation layer.
context.implementation: Reduced shared role heading scale, tightened fixed vertical offsets, changed comparison from accent-heavy cards to label/value rows, and retained the flat canvas and common footer.
context.result: The current ten-slide carousel exported at 1080 by 1080 with readable phone-size thumbnails, while short and long Arabic and mixed-script fixtures remained within safe bounds.

learning_points: Canvas-size layout checks do not replace a phone-size review.
Reusable templates need typography rules that accommodate content length without slide-specific selectors.
A quieter footer and smaller value hierarchy can improve reading order without adding metadata.
story_points: The design target was an editorial system rather than a single alert carousel.
The rejected redesign helped clarify which visual direction not to carry forward.
The comparison layout improved by removing repeated accent bars and using one readable hierarchy.
possible_angles: Why I now review carousel templates at 360 pixels before exporting.
The difference between fixing a slide and fixing a template.
How smaller typography can make technical Arabic carousels easier to read.

resources.description: Fresh 360 pixel-per-slide contact sheet from the verified template pass.

notes: The idea records a renderer-template improvement; it does not alter the approved alert-latency content.
